title: Udyam Digital: demo video script and test guide
subtitle: Airtel SYNC hackathon · 3-minute video · checked against the live system on 6 Nov 2026 (factory case re-checked after the fix)
setup: Start the stack: docker compose up -d (wait about a minute), then make seed if the database is new.
Start the web app: cd ts/apps/web, then npx next start -p 3000 -H 0.0.0.0.
Phone (web): open http://localhost:3000 in a 390×844 browser window, or in Chrome on a phone after adb reverse tcp:3000 tcp:3000 and adb reverse tcp:8080 tcp:8080.
Phone (Expo app): cd ts/apps/mobile, then npx expo start --port 19000 --localhost. Run adb reverse tcp:19000 tcp:19000 and open exp://127.0.0.1:19000 in Expo Go.
Run make scenarios once before recording, so the back office has leads, a review case and partner tasks.
Send one chat message first to warm up the LLM. The first reply of the day is the slowest.
Open docs/Udyam_Digital_SYNC_Submission.pptx on slide 2, and keep a terminal open in the repo.
script: Deck slide 2: the funnel and "1,485 drops (32%)"

Five thousand small-business leads, three hundred and sixty-eight activations. A third of the losses are friction: no time for a sales visit, quotes that take days, paperwork. Udyam Digital turns all of it into one phone session.
Phone home screen. Tap தமிழ், then the demo owner "Dental clinic, Chennai (Tamil)"
The owner picks a language: ten Indian languages, on the web or in our app.
Chat: send the prefilled Tamil message. The advisor answers in Tamil and the quote card shows ₹3,933 a month

Our AI advisor asks only what it needs and recommends a bundle in the owner's language. The AI never invents a product or a price: eligibility and pricing are rules in code, and a guard blocks any number the quote service did not produce.
Quote: switch on Backup 4G/5G Failover. The total goes to ₹4,507 a month plus ₹1,500 one-time. Tap Accept
One monthly price, the one-time charge shown separately, and add-ons with one switch. Dependencies are enforced.
Consent screen, then I agree
Consent comes first, per purpose, under the DPDP Act. The owner can withdraw it and delete everything in one tap.
KYC: upload data/kyc_documents/K04_gst_certificate.png, and "too blurry" appears. Then Use sample documents (K03), Check my documents, "All documents verified"

Smart KYC catches a blurred photo the moment it is taken. OCR reads the certificates, GSTIN and Udyam numbers are checked against the registries, and names, address, bill age and ID validity are cross-checked. All twelve test applicants come out as expected.
Track: the stepper runs to Live, and WhatsApp messages in Tamil appear
Instead of calling support, the owner gets a WhatsApp update at every step, in their language. If fibre is not possible at the address, we offer 5G AirFiber instead of losing the order.
Account (👤): sign in with a mobile number and the demo code. The past order is listed. Start a new order, then at KYC: Use your verified documents, Nothing has changed, Verified

Returning customers sign in with a one-time code, see every order and track it. A new order doesn't repeat the paperwork: we re-check the GST and Udyam registries live and the ID's validity. If nothing changed, it is verified in one tap. If anything changed, we ask for fresh documents.
Back office: KYC review queue. Open the K07 case (name mismatch) and Approve
Unclear cases, like a different name on one certificate, go to a human reviewer. We never silently reject a customer.
Back office: Leads by score, then Partner handoff
Field sales and partners get warm leads ranked by a propensity model that finds 2.4 times more buyers than random calling, with the advisor's summary attached.
Terminal: make scenarios ends with "33 passed, 0 failed". Then deck slide 8, the architecture
Thirty-three user stories pass against the live system, and in our failure drills no event was lost. We start with professional offices, then multi-site businesses and manufacturers. Thank you.

advisor.name: Dental clinic, Chennai (Tamil)
advisor.say: (prefilled) வணக்கம், நான் சென்னையில் ஒரு பல் மருத்துவமனை நடத்துகிறேன். 6 பேர் வேலை செய்கிறார்கள், ஒரே கிளை, GSTIN உள்ளது.
advisor.check: Reply is in Tamil. Switching on Failover (P09) adds ₹574/mo and ₹1,500 one-time, for ₹4,507/mo.

advisor.name: Kirana store, Lucknow (Hindi, no GSTIN)
advisor.say: (prefilled) Hindi: kirana shop, 2 staff, one shop, no GSTIN, wants UPI billing and internet
advisor.check: WhatsApp API (P15) and SMS (P14) are excluded because they need a GSTIN, and the reply says GST registration unlocks them. Tier 2, so no 1 Gbps.

advisor.name: CA firm asks for a firewall (English)
advisor.say: Hi, we are a CA firm in Pune with 8 employees, one office, we have GSTIN. We want a managed firewall and fast internet.
advisor.check: Managed Firewall (P21) is excluded (needs 10+ staff, they have 8), with Endpoint Security offered instead.

advisor.name: Restaurant chain, 5 sites, Bengaluru
advisor.say: We run 5 restaurants in Bengaluru, 40 staff in total, GSTIN registered. Need internet at every outlet, CCTV and billing.
advisor.check: Per-site lines on one bill. The advisor assumes 2 cameras per outlet and says so. SD-WAN (P10) is allowed (3+ sites, 10+ staff, GSTIN).

advisor.name: Just a mobile plan (Hinglish)
advisor.say: Bhai mujhe sirf 2 mobile connection chahiye business ke liye, Indore mein shop hai, GSTIN hai.
advisor.check: No bundle forced; the reply is in Hinglish with a soft upsell later.

advisor.name: Physio clinic, fibre not feasible (Hyderabad)
advisor.say: I run a physiotherapy clinic in Hyderabad, 5 staff, one branch, we have GSTIN. Need reliable internet and email.
advisor.check: After KYC (K09 passes), Track shows Delayed (fibre not feasible), then offers 5G AirFiber (P04). Accept it and the order goes Live.

advisor.name: Tier 2 city asks for a Tier 1 product
advisor.say: I run an architecture office in Nagpur, 12 staff, one office, GSTIN yes. I want the 1 Gbps fibre.
advisor.check: Biz Fibre 1G (P03) is refused (Tier 1 only), with Biz Fibre 300 offered as the closest option.

advisor.name: Small manufacturer, 40 staff, Pune
advisor.say: We are a small auto-parts manufacturer in Pune, 40 staff, one factory, GSTIN registered. Need internet and machine monitoring for 10 machines.
advisor.check: Monitoring for the 10 machines, Endpoint Security for the 40 staff (stated as an assumption). The reply says Machine Monitoring needs a 24-month contract.

advisor.name: CCTV only, no internet (Jaipur, no GSTIN)
advisor.say: I have a clothes shop in Jaipur, 3 staff, one shop, no GSTIN. I only want 2 CCTV cameras.
advisor.check: Cloud CCTV needs internet, so connectivity is added. The advisor also kept the shop bundle (POS, mobile line): say "only internet and cameras" to trim it.

advisor.name: "Too expensive" (Mumbai salon)
advisor.say: I run a small beauty salon in Mumbai, 3 staff, one shop, no GSTIN. Need internet and billing.  Then tap: Too expensive
advisor.check: A cheaper path with the total cost shown and the old price compared.

advisor.name: Re-quote: fewer cloud users (Delhi law office)
advisor.say: We are a law office in Delhi, 10 staff, one office, GSTIN yes.  Then: Only 5 people need cloud email
advisor.check: The new quote arrives in the same reply. It must not say "I'll update it later".

advisor.name: Tanglish (Coimbatore medical shop)
advisor.say: Vanakkam, enaku Coimbatore la oru chinna medical shop irukku, 2 per velai seiyuranga, GSTIN irukku. Billing machine um internet um venum.
advisor.check: Reply in Tanglish (Tamil in Latin letters), with an offer to switch to Tamil script.

kyc: GSTIN cancelled in the registry, and the Udyam number is blank
GST certificate tilted about 7°: straightened automatically
GST certificate heavily blurred: flagged as soon as it is uploaded
GSTIN typed with one wrong digit: checksum fails, closest registry match suggested
Legal name differs between the certificate and the registry
Clean; the GSTIN's letter O is read as zero and corrected by the registry
Clean; LLP signatory can't be checked against partners (no data)
kycRoutes: Order moves to KYC verified, then installation is scheduled, then Installing, then Live. A WhatsApp message goes out at each step.
The owner sees what is wrong with each document and how to fix it. Nothing is rejected.
The case appears in Back office → KYC review queue with the reasons. Approve moves the order on; Reject stops it with a message.
Blocked with a clear reason (e.g. GSTIN cancelled) and the next step to take; no order is provisioned.
reuse: Signed in, verified before, ticked "Nothing has changed"
Verified in one tap; the order shows the "KYC reused" badge
Yes: first order with K03, then a new order
Reuse card hides; the owner uploads new documents (full check)
"Ordered before? Sign in to skip the documents" link
Fresh documents: "more than a year old"
GSTIN cancelled or name/address changed in the registry
No reuse; full check (never a pass without the live check)
fulfilment: Quote accepted → KYC → KYC verified → Installation scheduled → Installing → Live (a few seconds each in the demo)
Lead IDs containing "nofibre" (demo owner: Physio clinic): Delayed → 5G AirFiber offered → accept → Live
On the consent or KYC page: withdraw → documents deleted → confirmation message
A custom request becomes a partner task with the chat summary (Back office → Partner handoff)
screens: Home: language, Start, demo owners, 👤 account
AI advisor chat with quick-reply chips and the quote card
Quote: lines, add-on switches, contract, Accept
Documents: camera upload, sample documents, reuse card, Check my documents
Order stepper and WhatsApp messages (/track?lead=… for a past order)
Sign in (mobile + code), verified business, all orders, new order
Back office: Orders, Leads by score, Partner handoff, KYC review queue, Messages, Status
Same steps as the web: Home → Chat → Quote → Consent → KYC → Track, plus 👤 Account
issues: The LLM's wording changes from run to run. The products and prices above are fixed by the rules for the same facts; if the advisor picks a different product, the price for that product is still rule-based.
In the Expo app, sign-in lasts until the app is closed.
No real SMS: the sign-in code is shown on screen (demo mode).
